title: Cause Clauses
description: Потому что, так как, поскольку, ведь
intro: Russian has several ways to express cause and reason. ПОТОМУ ЧТО (because) is most common and neutral. ТАК КАК (since/as) is slightly more formal and often begins sentences. ПОСКОЛЬКУ (since/inasmuch as) is formal/written. ВЕДЬ (after all/you see) adds emotional emphasis or reminds of known information. ИЗ-ЗА ТОГО ЧТО (because of the fact that) emphasizes negative causes. Choose based on formality and emphasis.
rules: Потому что = because (neutral, most common): Я опоздал, потому что был дождь.
Так как = since/as (formal, often sentence-initial): Так как было поздно, мы ушли.
Поскольку = since/inasmuch as (formal/written): Поскольку он болен, он не придёт.
Ведь = after all/you see (emotional, reminds): Помоги мне, ведь ты мой друг!
examples: Я не пришёл, потому что заболел. (I didn't come because I got sick.)
Так как магазин был закрыт, мы пошли домой. (Since the store was closed, we went home.)
Поскольку результаты известны, можно начинать. (Since the results are known, we can begin.)
Не волнуйся, ведь всё будет хорошо! (Don't worry, after all everything will be fine!)

items.prompt: Я не смог прийти, _____ был занят. (I couldn't come because I was busy.)
items.promptEnglish: I couldn't come because I was busy.

items.prompt: _____ было уже поздно, мы решили остаться. (Since it was already late, we decided to stay.)
items.promptEnglish: Since it was already late, we decided to stay.
items.explanation: Formal sentence-initial cause uses так как.

items.prompt: Помоги мне, _____ ты мой друг! (Help me, after all you're my friend!)
items.promptEnglish: Help me, after all you're my friend!

items.prompt: _____ все документы готовы, можно подписать договор. (Since all documents are ready, we can sign the contract.)
items.promptEnglish: Since all documents are ready, we can sign the contract.

items.prompt: Он не пришёл на работу, _____ заболел. (He didn't come to work because he got sick.)
items.promptEnglish: He didn't come to work because he got sick.

items.prompt: Не беспокойся, _____ я всё сделаю! (Don't worry, I'll do everything, you know!)
_____ у меня не было денег, я не купил билет. (Since I didn't have money, I didn't buy a ticket.)
items.promptEnglish: Since I didn't have money, I didn't buy a ticket.

items.prompt: Мы опоздали, _____ автобус сломался. (We were late because the bus broke down.)
items.promptEnglish: We were late because the bus broke down.
items.hint: Explaining reason after result = потому что
items.explanation: Cause after result uses потому что.

items.prompt: Ты должен понять, _____ это важно! (You must understand, after all this is important!)
items.promptEnglish: You must understand, this is important!

blanks: Мы не пошли гулять, _____ шёл дождь. (We didn't go for a walk because it was raining.)
_____ было поздно, магазины закрылись. (Since it was late, the stores closed.)
Я остался дома, _____ плохо себя чувствовал. (I stayed home because I felt unwell.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Cause conjunctions: потому что (because, after main clause), так как (since, before main clause)
hints: Cause after the main clause — which conjunction?
Cause at the beginning of the sentence — which conjunction?
Cause after the main clause — which conjunction?
explanations: Потому что (because) gives the reason after the main clause.
Так как (since) introduces the reason at the beginning of the sentence.
Потому что is the most common cause conjunction after the main clause.
